description:
Port the autocomplete infrastructure from interactive-mode.ts (lines 400-550) and autocomplete.ts.

Implement:
- AutocompleteProvider behaviour: complete(prefix) → [%Suggestion{label, value, description}]
- SlashCommandProvider: parses /command prefix, returns matching commands
- CombinedProvider: chains multiple providers, deduplicates
- Built-in commands: /help, /clear, /model, /theme, /compact, /cost, /config
- Extension command integration (pull from Dispatcher.get_all_commands)

Does NOT include the dropdown UI (that's the next ticket).
Upstream: interactive-mode.ts autocomplete setup, packages/tui/src/autocomplete.ts
title: Autocomplete provider API + slash-command framework
